statements.text: In most dream and waking states a unit of identification determines the experience "I am this". Its minimal form is transparent spatiotemporal self-location, and its maximal form may be the quality of consciousness as such, with which some meditators and some out-of-body experiencers seem to identify.

sources.quote: In most dream and waking states there is a unit of identification (UI), determining the conscious experience of “I am this!”
Arguably, this is the experiential quality of consciousness per se
